newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ budget fiscal indicator little changed - DMG.
newsitem.headline: NZ budget fiscal indicator little changed - DMG.

text.p: The coalition government's first budget implies a neutral fiscal policy over the next three years, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell (DMG) said on Thursday.
"That outlook compares with the substantial fiscal contraction that would have occurred under the policies pursued by the previous government," DMG chief economist Ulf Schoefisch said.
"Rather than being expansionary, this budget simply puts fiscal policy back on a neutral track," he said.
DMG produces a fiscal indicator which shows whether fiscal policy is becoming more expansionary or contractionary.
"Based on budget numbers, the fiscal indicator suggests a slightly expansionary policy stance over 1997/98," DMG said.
"That will be offset by a slight contraction of similar size in the following two years," it said.
